title: Welcome to Platmosphere 2026!
abstract: Kickstart your Platmosphere experience with our opening welcome talk! Join us as we set the stage for an exciting event ahead, sharing key insights, highlights, and what to expect throughout the day.

title: Reinventing The Dev Team
abstract: I don’t need to tell you that AI has changed software development forever. You know this. Whether you’re positive, negative or indifferent to this change, you can’t deny that the past 2 years have radically changed the role of the software developer.  Just a few years ago I would have advocated for The Balanced Team. A Product Manager, a Product Designer, an Engineering Manager and 4-8 Developers. It worked.  18 months ago I was telling people that “I’ve never seen a dev team get to the end of their backlog, I don’t see that happening”. I’ve seen it now. Actually, I’ve seen it more than once.  The balanced team as we knew it doesn’t work any more.  The seismic shift in software is only just getting started. I don’t offer a proven strategy to navigate this change, we are sailing these turbulent waters together. What I propose is that we go back to fundamentals, refocus on outcomes and evaluate our options for evolving team composition. In this talk I bring you these options, what I’ve seen work, what I’m ready to throw out, and most importantly, the things I will keep no matter what.

title: GenAI as a catalyst of collaboration platforms among teams
abstract: Generative AI is changing the way organizations collaborate. Beyond personal productivity, it has the potential to become the core infrastructure of new internal platforms — systems that connect people, knowledge, and decisions. This talk explores how GenAI can act as a co-thinker, enabling teams to reason together, share insights, and build collective intelligence. Through the lens of Platform Thinking, we’ll see how organizations can move from isolated efficiency to shared reflection, transforming GenAI from a tool into an innovation platform. Real-world experiments, such as the case of Fujitsu, show how AI can foster cross-functional collaboration and knowledge exchange across silos. The real opportunity lies not in automating work, but in creating the conditions for teams — and entire organizations — to think together, faster and deeper than before.

title: Falling in Love with Platform Engineering: The CUPID Way
abstract: "In recent years, large organizations have adopted Internal Developer Portals (IDPs) to balance governance and autonomy. Despite their promise, many platforms prioritize compliance over usability. This talk explores enhancing platform engineering through principles like product mindset, user experience, and key metrics, while questioning the optimal granularity of services in the “Golden Path.” Inspired by Dan North’s “Joyful Software”, during this talk the concept of “Joyful Engineering” and the CUPID principles are proposed to transform service building approaches. By focusing on self-containment, idempotency and single purpose, organizations can improve service acceptance and foster collaboration. Key takeaways include: - Understanding why IDPs aren’t a magic solution for developer experience. - Finding the balance between autonomy and governance. - Adoption of Cupid Principles (Composable, Unix Philosophy, Predictable, Idiomatic, Domain-based) to Platform Engineering. - Leveraging the “Everything as Code” mindset with Agentic AI to shape the future of developer experience."

title: Helvetia's Platform Journey: From Legacy to AI-Powered Innovation
abstract: Maurizio Sala, Head IT Application Service Management at Gruppo Helvetia Italia, unveils the remarkable seven-year journey behind the creation of their Digital Integration Hub. Maurizio will detail how Gruppo Helvetia Italia transitioned from the initial legacy system to leveraging Mia-Platform Fast Data, enabling seamless data flow to all channels without querying underlying technical systems. The presentation will highlight the platform's continuous evolution, including the integration of new functionalities, collaboration with external development teams, and the exciting prospect of new integrations with external partners. Maurizio will share how this powerful tool has delivered significant benefits to the company thus far. Looking ahead, the discussion will pivot to the future challenges and opportunities. Thanks to the Digital Integration Hub, Gruppo Helvetia Italia has established the crucial foundation and data necessary to fuel AI systems, paving the way for high-value use cases. A prime example is their innovative new claims management engine, entirely AI-based and orchestrated through Mia-Platform. Don't miss this insightful deep dive into Gruppo Helvetia Italia's pioneering work in digital transformation and AI integration.

title: Scaling Financial Trust: How CRIF Orchestrates AI and Composability to Accelerate Global Fintech Innovation
abstract: In an increasingly global and competitive fintech market, it is necessary to adopt strategies to scale the business while optimizing costs and time-to-market. With this in mind, CRIF has chosen a composable business model to organize and develop its digital services offering, maximizing the reuse of existing assets. To support this vision, CRIF has created a platform that includes a catalog of the components of the offering and uses it as a knowledge base for a specialized AI assistant. Through the platform interface, it is possible to interact with the agent by providing a list of requirements; the AI analyzes the requests and proposes solutions that favor the reuse and evolution of already available components. This tool allows CRIF to significantly reduce the time needed to define precise and modular solutions, accelerating innovation and the ability to respond to market needs.

title: From Machine to Insight: How N-and Built an AI-Ready Data Platform on Mia-Platform Fast Data
abstract: N-and operates at the intersection of physical and digital commerce: thousands of vending machines in the field, a consumer loyalty app, and a growing need to turn fragmented operational data into business value.  By adopting Mia-Platform Fast Data, we unified two fundamentally different data worlds: telemetry streams from machines on field — carrying purchase transactions, audit trails, and operational signals — and behavioral events from the CoffeeApp, including loyalty interactions, ad engagement, and redemptions. The result is a set of Data Products that give the entire organization a single, trusted view of customers, machines, and transactions. What makes this journey distinctive is how we accelerated delivery. We developed AI-powered skills that automate the creation of Single View configurations directly from incoming event schemas and aggregation templates, dramatically reducing the time from data source to Data Product. Alongside this, we adopted decision tables — driven by business rules written in Rego — to express complex aggregation logic in a format that business and technology teams can read, validate, and evolve together, without touching the underlying pipeline code. The outcome is a scalable, event-driven infrastructure where real-time data from the physical and digital world converges into standardized views that feed dashboards, operational systems, and AI agents — and where the rules that govern that data are owned by the business, not buried in code.

title: From Home Care to Digital Ecosystem: The Composable Transformation of ItaliAssistenza’s Patient Support Programs
abstract: Discover how ItaliAssistenza redefined Patient Support Programs. Join us to explore how a cloud-native, composable architecture can digitize homecare, telemedicine, and logistics in just 6 months. We’ll reveal how a platform can unify doctors, patients, and ops centers, managing +60k home visits with ease. Learn to leverage holistic data for superior therapeutic adherence and scalable care. Don't miss this blueprint for the future of Digital Health!

title: Quixa's transformation Journey: How to build a data platform to unlock the value of data
abstract: Quixa shares how it overcame the limitations of legacy systems by creating a modern and scalable Data Platform. The company leveraged a Digital Integration Hub (DIH) architecture to aggregate fragmented data from legacy systems into a unified Data Product, to be exposed to front-end touchpoints.  This solution offloaded the core systems, ensuring high performance and reliability for digital touchpoints while streamlining data access for applications. The presentation will explore the key decision drivers, technical challenges, the adoption journey, and the results achieved, while also looking at how this project serves as a catalyst for future innovation.

title: Mobility 5.0: The Future of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), balancing AI & Cyber Risks
abstract: The Italian transport sector is undergoing a landmark transformation driven by EU Directive 2661/23 and Decree 40. The advent of ""Mobility 5.0"" integrates autonomous vehicles and Mobility as a Service (MaaS), presenting a crucial challenge: balancing AI efficiency with the growing cyber threats to critical infrastructure and real-time data.  In this roundtable moderated by TTS Italia, industry leaders will analyze how to combine regulatory innovation with operational security. The discussion will highlight the role of technological platforms as essential enablers of governance, compliance, and data protection within an increasingly interconnected and data-driven ecosystem.

title: Augmented FinOps: Master Cloud Governance in the AI Era
abstract: Cloud adoption promises increased agility, scalable and reliable architectures, progressive and sustainable growth, and an economic model fully aligned with consumption. These capabilities enable organizations to innovate faster, optimize costs, and adapt to market demands with greater resilience. Traditional FinOps approaches are reactive: how much did we spend? Where could we have saved? But in an AI-native platform world, this passive stance is no longer enough. Augmented FinOps shifts the paradigm from cost analysis to predictive cost governance.

title: Addressing the challenges of Immune Mediated Inflammatory Disease's (IMIDs) by the First Time Right I-Mart transcriptomic platform
abstract: Developing Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) for Immune-Mediated Inflammatory Diseases requires a robust, compliant technical foundation. This session explores how First Time Right DX (FTR DX) accelerated the launch of their I-Mart platform by building directly on Mia-Care’s specialized infrastructure.  Co-founder Andrea Fiumicelli will share how FTR DX innovates the market by unifying physicians, labs, and bioinformaticians into a seamless, SaMD-compliant workflow. We detail the transition from manual biopsy interpretation to an automated system for longitudinal disease tracking and AI-enhanced decision support. Attendees will learn how I-Mart orchestrates the diagnostic lifecycle—from kit scanning to data analysis—on a natively hosted infrastructure. Discover how this partnership allows innovators to focus on clinical excellence while Mia-Care manages the complexities of scale and regulatory compliance.

title: The Future of Banking: How Agentic AI & Ecosystem Orchestration are Reshaping Financial Services
abstract: The financial services industry is undergoing a profound transformation, driven by the shift toward agentic AI and complex ecosystem orchestration. Moving beyond basic automation to autonomous workflows and seamless cross-platform management, innovation is redefining how banks operate and interact with customers. This round table will bring together industry leaders to explore the key trends shaping the future of banking, the role of fintech collaborations, and the challenges of navigating new regulations such as DORA and the AI Act. Join us to discuss the strategies and technologies that will define the next era of financial services while balancing security, compliance, and user experience in an orchestrated digital world.

title: Master the Vibe
abstract: As the AI revolution and the 'SaaSpocalypse' reshape the landscape, legacy systems are naturally reaching their limits. We are moving toward Vibe Engineering, where technology is most effective when grounded in context. To ensure productivity remains sustainable amidst new data and regulatory demands, we need a clear, integrated strategy. Transitioning to a Modern IDP allows us to harmonize human expertise and AI within a single workflow. This isn’t just a technical shift, but a cultural evolution—one where we refine our processes and empower our people to truly Master the Vibe.

title: From Care Pathways to Clinical Platforms: Building a Scalable Foundation for Data-Driven Healthcare and Future SaMD Modules
abstract: Healthcare delivery for chronic and complex conditions remains hindered by fragmented tools, duplicated data entry, and limited coordination across professionals and settings. Jua Pro is a clinical coordination platform enabling integrated, interoperable, and workflow-driven care pathways. It provides healthcare teams with a unified environment to access longitudinal patient data, collaborate in real time, automate administrative tasks, and orchestrate care processes across hospital and community settings. Rather than starting as a medical device, Jua adopts a modular, progressive approach: separating core platform capabilities from future regulated functionalities. This allows rapid deployment of high-value features while preparing a clear roadmap toward the certification of selected modules as Class I and Class IIa Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). This approach is supported by Mia-Care’s platform, which provides a compliant-by-design technical foundation. By leveraging Mia-Care, Jua has been able to accelerate early development and structure its architecture to meet future regulatory requirements without slowing down product iteration. This talk will explore how a platform-first, modular strategy enables faster innovation cycles while maintaining a clear path toward regulatory compliance, and how this paradigm can help bridge the gap between digital health tools and certified medical-grade software.

title: A Harness for Behaviour: Ensuring AI-generated Code Does What We Want - TDD in the Age of AI
abstract: How do we know if our application functionally behaves the way we need it to? How do we guide agents so that it does what we need?  My colleague Birgitta Böckeler observes: At the moment, most people who give high autonomy to their coding agents do this: - Feed-forward: A functional specification (of varying levels of detail, from a short prompt to multi-file descriptions) - Feed-back: Check if the AI-generated test suite is green, has reasonably high coverage, some might even monitor its quality with mutation testing. Then combine that with manual testing.  You might expect that the AI-generated tests are being carefully read and reviewed; after all, they are our first line of defense, aren't they? But in practice, reading a lot of test code is even harder than reading a lot of generated production code. So we end up glancing at the tests and quickly skimming the test names. As a result, many practitioners who are otherwise very proficient with coding agents, are not feeling as confident about behaviour as we might expect.  In this presentation, I argue that the problem is not with the tests, but with test-as-code, and I propose test-as-fixtures as a better alternative. There is a convergence of approaches: in the Go testing tradition, most tests are tabular, and the part you will want to read is not the test code, but the table. And when the table grows, it can be moved to text files. Something similar happens in the approval testing tradition, where we use custom printers to delete extraneous detail from an application output and compare it with an approved version. This is captured in the Approved Fixtures pattern, published by Ivett Ördög in the Augmented Coding Patterns.  The advantage of fixtures is that they are basically pairs of (input, expected output), and are expressed in a human-friendly notation, and they are much easier and more fun to manually verify than test code.  Because fixtures are easy to read, they restore a tests-first workflow: whether written by the developer or generated by the agent, the fixtures are reviewed and approved before implementation begins, and executed whenever the application changes, thus restoring our faith in the behaviour of our applications.

title: Finding the Flow: How UlixePay Built a Next-Gen Wallet in Record Time
abstract: The digital payments market is undergoing a complete transformation as the Digital Euro and stablecoins are opening up unprecedented scenarios for growth and innovation. However, delivering a modern payment experience requires a perfectly synced technical ecosystem.  In this session, UlixePay share the behind-the-scenes story of developing the UlixePay Wallet. We will discuss the pragmatic challenges of integrating complex banking services and how the partnership utilized Mia-Platform’s Catalog and intelligent capabilities to accelerate development and streamline integrations.  By focusing on a composable approach, the team was able to "Master The Vibe" of the project—harmonizing regulatory requirements with radical agility. Join us to see how clear collaboration and the right technology stack can turn a complex BaaS integration into a successful, user-centric reality ready for the 2026 market.

title: Enter the Flow: From Vibe Coding to Vibe Engineering
abstract: Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor. Vibe coding feels like magic, until that magic hits the wall of enterprise reality: compliance, ownership, integrations, scale. The shortcut from vibe coding to vibe engineering is having Context. In this session we'll show you the modern SDLC as a butterfly: one wing is experiment (anyone can build, fast), the other is engineering (governance, scale). What sits in the middle is the Context Catalog: a living digital twin of your organization. We'll walk this flow end-to-end. First, a look at the Catalog as the single source of truth: connectors, item types, relationships, scorecards. Then we'll watch a business-tech stakeholder turn an idea into a working application using Mia-Flow, with the Catalog injecting compliance rules and architectural patterns automatically.

title: Vibe in Regulated Industries: the Gap No One Planned for
abstract: The tension between "shipping fast" and "staying compliant" reaches a peak when healthcare teams integrate AI features into certified legacy platforms, resulting in a modern compliance collision under evolving frameworks like the EU AI Act, FDA PCCP, and GMLP. This burden is compounded by years of "legacy compliance debt" layered onto ambiguous AI obligations. The session demonstrates how an AI-powered gap analysis can quickly ingest the legacy codebase and new AI modules to surface every regulatory shortfall—such as missing explainability evidence or bias documentation—in a fraction of the time required by manual consultancy. The presentation shows how these gaps are transformed into a prioritized, framework-tagged remediation plan for the development team. Ultimately, the session explores how to navigate this new category of compliance debt, ensuring innovation is not sacrificed for regulatory necessity.

title: Closing Keynote with Special Guest: Layla Pavone, Comune di Milano
abstract: We conclude the day with a special guest who will share the perspective of a city at the forefront of digitalization in Europe and the world: Milan. We will reflect on the impact of technology on society and the collective actions we can take as citizens, businesses, and institutions.

title: Harmonizing the Data Revolution: Aindo’s Vision for Clinical-Grade Synthetic Evidence
abstract: Aindo is leading a shift in digital health by unlocking the 95% of biomedical data currently siloed behind privacy barriers. To truly Master The Vibe of modern healthcare, Aindo utilizes generative AI to create synthetic data that perfectly replicates complex clinical patterns while remaining entirely anonymous. This innovation accelerates research timelines—transforming 9-month data access hurdles into instant availability for high-impact use cases like rare tumor modeling.  The key to Aindo’s success lies in its "clinical-grade" commitment. By leveraging the P4SaMD framework to develop its solutions, Aindo ensures its technology is not just mathematically accurate but also meets the rigorous regulatory standards required for medical device software. This session highlights how Aindo empowers researchers to scale Real-World Evidence securely, demonstrating that the future of medicine is built on data that is both high-fidelity and fully compliant.

title: Mastering Payments in the Era of AI: The Flow Behind BFF Bank’s PayConnect
abstract: In the age of Vibe Engineering, the goal of finance is to turn fragmented data into a seamless, intelligent rhythm. BFF Bank presents PayConnect, an omnichannel platform designed to harmonize corporate collections using AI-driven automation.  By leveraging Mia-Platform’s AI-native foundation, BFF Bank has moved beyond static rules to intelligent, pattern-based reconciliation and real-time monitoring. We will explore how a composable, API-first architecture allows AI agents to orchestrate complex financial flows, eliminating friction and manual errors. Join us to see how BFF Bank is mastering the payment vibe, transforming legacy complexity into a modern, fluid, and AI-accelerated experience.

title: Intelligent Application Platform - Engineering the Intelligent Enterprise
abstract: The future of enterprise software is shifting from isolated, static tools to Intelligent Application Platforms. These platforms don’t just host AI; they act as a cohesive nervous system, leveraging Agentic AI and composable architecture to orchestrate dynamic, outcome-driven workflows. This session explores how leaders can move beyond simple AI integration to build a robust platform foundation. We will dive into the shift from deterministic logic to autonomous orchestration, where AI agents utilize metadata-rich APIs to navigate complex business processes. By focusing on the convergence of fluid knowledge, connected data, and adaptive user experiences, we will outline a blueprint for a platform that learns from user interaction and scales intelligence across the entire organization.

title: Observing the Unobservable: when Platform Observability meets AI agents
abstract: Platform Engineering teams running Kubernetes-based IDPs have solved observability for modern workloads. Prometheus scrapes metrics, Loki aggregates logs, Tempo stores distributed traces, OpenTelemetry instruments everything, and Grafana ties it together. For microservices, APIs, and databases, that stack works. It handles scale, it handles failure and it handles cardinality.   Then AI agents enter the platform as first-class workloads and the assumptions that underpinned that observability stack start to crack. Not because the stack is wrong, but because agents behave differently. A microservice executes deterministic logic and returns a result while an AI agent reasons across multiple steps, selects and calls tools dynamically, retrieves context from vector stores, chains LLM calls, and produces outputs that are non-deterministic by design. A span that shows 200 OK and 1.4 seconds tells you nothing about whether the agent reached the right conclusion, used the right context, or stayed within safe operational boundaries. This talk walks through the concrete evolution of a production observability stack as AI agents are introduced to the platform. Starting from a standard observability setup, this session covers the new challenges that are introduced by AI agents and how to face them.

title: Fireside Chat: Scaling AI in the High-Stakes World of Finance
abstract: The financial services market stands at a critical crossroads. While the AI revolution promises unprecedented competitive advantage, scaling it across complex organizations requires navigating shifting regulations, cultural inertia, and structural friction. In this high-stakes environment, AI transformation is no longer just an engineering challenge—it is a profound leadership imperative. This fireside chat brings together elite perspectives from the front lines of enterprise consulting, fintech ecosystem growth, and digital banking leadership. Together, the panel will dissect immediate market friction points and long-term opportunities ahead, offering actionable takeaways for modern executives. Join us to uncover what it truly takes to champion innovation, overcome organizational inertia, and effectively lead systemic change in the future of finance.

title: The Accord: The Agent Train Method for Production AI
abstract: A great perfume is composed in layers, each note doing one job, together becoming unforgettable. Production AI deserves the same discipline. Today it rarely gets it. One large agent is asked to do everything at once, the fastest way to start, and the most expensive way to keep going. Tokens burn. Decisions blur. Every change feels like a refactor. This session will explore the Agent Train: a chain of small, specialized AI agents, each guided by its own Mermaid diagram, directing without dictating, composing without colliding. Through a real failure-analysis case, I'll share the exact architecture, the Mermaid-guided pattern that keeps token costs down, and how to slip the train into a system that's already running, no refactor required. By the end, you'll know how to compose your own Agent Train.

title: Building "AI-Ready" Architectures with Mia-Platform
abstract: In the modern enterprise, one of the biggest problems to innovation is the friction of data fragmentation. Most organizations spend a lot of time finding, cleaning, and understanding data before a single line of application code is even written. But what if your data architecture was "self-describing" and ready to be consumed by both humans and AI? This talk describes a modern Data Fabric approach. We will move beyond specific use cases to explore a universal architectural pattern for building data-driven applications. We will dive into the three pillars of an actionable data strategy: Data Catalog & Lineage: How to create a shared semantic layer where every data point is enriched with business context and traced back to its source, eliminating ambiguity. Real-time Data Pipelines: The methodology for orchestrating flows from legacy systems into Single Views: unified, high-performance data products ready for API consumption. AI-design of an application: We will demonstrate how easy it is to design an application while interacting with Mia-Platform Data Fabric. By the end of this session, you will see how a Solution Architect can design a complex application simply by ""talking"" to the system. Through governed metadata and lineage, the AI understands the context, fetches the right data schemas, and accelerates the design & building process.

title: For a Europe That Wins in Tech
abstract: Can Europe truly compete in the global tech race? The answer lies in our ability to build, own, and scale our own technological foundations. This session dives deep into the "European Tech Stack," examining how the convergence of Sovereign Cloud, decentralized data ecosystems, and localized AI models are reshaping the continent’s strategic landscape. Our panelists—representing leading research institutions, public authorities, and tech pioneers—will discuss the practicalities of breaking dependencies on external providers. We will explore how fostering a robust, local ecosystem is not just a political necessity, but a massive economic opportunity for European enterprises and developers alike.
